messages:
maria: Heads-up — found two issues in the Starter Credentials walkthrough: the auth env var key is wrong (uses REDWOOD_TOKEN instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY) and the embed link to the sample deploy script 404s. Anyone around to patch?

sam: I can take the link 404. Where's the orig file? docs repo or website? :eyes:

maria: docs repo. path: /docs/guides/starter/credentials.md. Small snippet shows:
```
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=sk-...
```
should be:
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
```
Also the deploy script link points to /scripts/deploy-old.sh which was removed in last cleanup.

kevin: I'll open a PR to fix both. Plan: update env var text, replace link with inline container run example, and add note about service account rotate. Branch: docs/fix/starter-creds-authkey-link

lia: can we also add a tiny quickstart paragraph that shows `--env-file .env` usage? new users trip on that. If it's small let's include it in the same PR.

sam: ack. I'll test the container command locally. Quick run:
```
docker run --env-file .env --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/sample-hello:latest
```
Works, but I had to set REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env. I'll add validation note.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created — https://deploy-preview-789.docs.redwood.com — status: success :white_check_mark:

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — added tests, updated links, added env-file paragraph. cc @maria @sam

maria: Thanks! I'll quick review today and check sample app on my laptop. :thumbsup:

sam: left one nit about wording on rotate note. otherwise LGTM. :eyes:

lia: can we add a changelog bullet under "docs updates" for this fix? small line is fine. we track doc changes for release notes.

kevin: added changelog entry in PR description.

maria: merging after deploy preview snapshot verified. Please squash and merge when ready. :shipit:

kevin: merged and pushed. release-notes tag added. Thanks everyone.

sam: verified local sample app with .env and the updated snippet. all good.

maria: closing loop — updated onboarding checklist item to reference corrected doc. I'll sync with support to update canned responses.

lia: great, moving to done. :tada:
